entities.summary: Ildemaro José Vargas Barreto is a Venezuelan professional baseball infielder for the Arizona Diamondbacks of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Minnesota Twins, Chicago Cubs, Pittsburgh Pirates, and Washington Nationals.
